title: Special Edition: The Shield Hero’s Valentine’s Day Part 13
text: After we finished buying the chocolate, we got to work making handmade chocolate in the village.

When I tried to assign Imiya and the other Lumo to a different task—since their fur meant they couldn’t participate—Imiya went and made something that looked like full-body protective gear. Apparently, this would let them work without their fur getting mixed in. Plus, it had a feature that used a tiny bit of Magical Power to eliminate the heat and stuffiness.

I almost wanted to ask, “Who asked you to go that far?” but I was impressed by her enthusiasm for the work, so I decided to let her do as she pleased. In the village’s temporary kitchen, everyone skilled with their hands or at cooking is currently working together to make chocolate. There have been a fair number of failed attempts, but so far, things are going smoothly.
So, I made my way to the village’s research lab, but…
“Mana, Michisafubihachimo. Zofhimimo?”
“I don’t understand a word of that monster language!”

Rat greeted me in a language I couldn’t understand. I guess this is what they call “monster language.” Judging by how Taniko is able to converse normally, maybe if I could decipher it, I’d be able to talk too. Well, I’m not about to go through the hassle of learning a new language, though. Besides, the Legendary Weapons were supposed to have a translation function, but it seems even the Shield Hero can’t understand monster language.
“You’re investigating the Chocolate Monster boss with Taniko, right?”
“Hm? Shield Hero?”
Taniko came up behind Rat and replied.
“How’s it going?”

“Yeah. Um… Apparently, all we have to do is build an altar in the area where the Chocolate Monsters spawn, make some chocolate nearby, and offer up the tastiest one. If the nearby monsters taste it and are satisfied, they’ll calm down.”
“Ah… I see.”

So it was one of those “let’s do the festival properly” types, was it? Why did a simple gift for the opposite sex turn into such a hassle? Could it be that Christmas-related events are the same kind of thing? Nah, probably not.
“So? What happened to the Chocolate Monster that came to the village?”
“It’s right there, isn’t it?”

When I looked, a brown creature with a rabbit-like appearance peeked out from the shadow of the door, glancing my way… One-head-tall with long ears… Is it a bit taller than Usapil? What is this? Has it shrunk? It has a ★ on its forehead.
“I talked to it, and it calmed down… It said it really liked the chocolate treats the Shield Hero made.”
“Did you feed it some?”
“If you’re asking what the best chocolate is in this village, it’s got to be the one the Shield Hero made, right?”
“Cure! Cure, cure!”
It looks like Gaelion is having a conversation with the chocolate monster. They start discussing something with great enthusiasm.
“Gaelion’s been really into making chocolate lately… even though he’s a dragon.”
“He likes sweets, doesn’t he?”
“Yeah, but… is he trying to make some legendary chocolate with rare ingredients or something?”
“Michisafukiryohoshimagemichinbihachi-mo?”
“I wonder if that’s it?”
Rat… I have no idea what he’s saying, but I guess I can take that as him agreeing with me? Taniko tilted her head but seemed to accept it for the time being.
“Anyway, let’s let the affected areas know.”
“Okay.”

And so, preparations for the chocolate event were steadily moving forward. Just as Taniko and the others had reported, it seems that as soon as the chocolate was offered, the monsters that appear on Valentine’s Day did indeed become somewhat tamer. It’s not as if there were no damage at all, but the reports had visibly decreased… or so they say.

Chocolate production was now on track, and the plan to turn Keel into an idol was also progressing smoothly. With the Valentine’s Day-exclusive monsters now subdued, Ren had some breathing room, so he reassigned him to work with Itsuki and the others, who were tasked with capturing the slave hunters.

Come to think of it, Itsuki didn’t seem all that interested in Valentine’s Day. Well, he’ll definitely get some from Rishia, though. He’s probably prioritizing stopping the bad guys who are causing trouble for the world over getting chocolate. In game terms, would that be the “Justice Ending”? Well, at least he’s got Rishia, so it’s not so bad.

As for Motoyasu… it seems he’s still chasing after Filo as usual. Since the King & Queen Cup is held around White Day, he’s probably a bit bored with all the free time on his hands. I sent him to help Ren and the others… but I doubt it’ll work out. He used to be a popular, good-looking guy with a great social life—it’s just pitiful.
Just then, I happened to come across Fohl talking to a Tailor for some reason.
“So, to make Atla fall for you—”
What on earth are they talking about? Fohl is nodding with an incredibly serious look on his face. Is that Gaelion next to him? This guy’s been popping up out of nowhere lately.
“So, here’s what I’m thinking—”
They’re too far away for me to hear. I’m curious what they’re talking about… but I’m busy myself, so maybe I should just hurry on my way?
“Naofumi-sama. What are you doing?”
…If Fohl is over there and Atla isn’t, that means Atla’s coming over to me.
“Atla, why aren’t you being held captive by Fohl?”
“I’m always with Naofumi-sama.”
“Oh, yeah, yeah.”

Lately, she’s been spending more time with Fohl… or rather, I’ve been letting her. I do make time for her when we’re relaxing in the village, though. It’s a good thing Raphtalia’s out inspecting the venue right now. It would’ve been a real commotion if she’d been here.
“So? What’s Fohl up to?”
“I’m not constantly keeping an eye on what my big brother is doing, you know.”
“Actually, you’re the one being watched, aren’t you?”
She’s been pretty well-behaved since Christmas. Maybe the effect of the decoy doll is wearing off? I’m debating whether to ask Imiya to make another one next time.
“Oh?”
Atla noticed the leader of the Chocolate Monsters, who had been hiding in the shadow of a tree and watching us. She floated over toward them.
“Oh…”

Then Atla seemed to start communicating with the Chocolate Monster—with her eyes… even though she can’t see. Hmm… I sense something unsettling, but both of them scatter whenever I approach. I hope nothing’s wrong… And so, the days passed until Valentine’s Day.
Valentine’s Day.
“Good morning, Naofumi-sama.”
“Rafu.”
“Good morning, Raphtalia. Raph-chan.”
“Um… yes. Here’s some chocolate.”
“Rafu!”
I woke up in my room at home, and Raphtalia and Raph-chan each handed me a wrapped box. I accepted them without hesitation. So Raph-chan is giving me some, too? I’m genuinely happy about that.

Back when I was in Japan, thanks to the “Chocolate Demon” and my chocolate-making, I’d receive “obligatory chocolates” on Valentine’s Day, but compared to getting them from Raphtalia and Raph-chan, it just didn’t feel the same—it really touched my heart differently.
“Well then, today is Filo’s Valentine’s event. It’s going to be a busy day.”
“Please do your best.”
“Rafu!”
“Raphtalia, you’ll be busy helping out too, but please do your best.”
“Yes.”
With that, I headed to the dining hall while chatting with Raphtalia about the day’s plans. Then, the villagers came over to give me chocolate. But… there were so many that I couldn’t carry them all.
“You’re quite the hit with the ladies, Naofumi-sama.”
“They’re just obligatory chocolates.”

I put the massive pile of chocolate into a bag to carry it. Sorry, but could you guys just deliver this to my house? Just as I was thinking that, I saw a mountain of them piling up next to my house. It seemed the Filolials and the Raphtalia Raph-species had each made their own chocolates and left them there. After asking Raphtalia to deliver them to my house, I went to the kitchen to prepare and serve breakfast.

Then, once everyone had finished breakfast, the day began. And… I happened to see Ren opening and closing the mailbox in front of his house. He was leaning against it, opening and closing it every ten seconds.

…Are you some guy who didn’t get any chocolate?! Do that kind of thing after school or something! Well, I mean… this isn’t exactly school, though. Plus, he seemed to be looking around nervously, searching for Taniko and the female knight.
“What’s up, Ren?”
“Um…”
“What are you doing?”
Even though Ren was acting strange, they were just tilting their heads in confusion. This… doesn’t look like he’s going to get any.
“Let’s go.”
“Aren’t we supposed to take out the relay base of those slave hunters today?”
“R-right, that’s right.”

Saying that, Ren gazed off in a different direction. When I followed his line of sight, I caught the moment Rishia was handing a piece of chocolate to Itsuki. Ren… was staring with eyes full of envy at the moment Rishia shyly handed the chocolate to Itsuki. Just like at Christmas—why did Ren end up with this kind of role, anyway?

By the way, it’s not like he doesn’t get any chocolate. A few pieces have been delivered to the front of Ren’s house, too. After all, there are some folks in the village who respect him. There are even slaves who make presents for all the heroes. It’s just that it feels like he won’t be getting chocolate from his two main crushes.
